explanation: The first statement asserts the mechanism as established antitumor effect generally, omitting that the reduced proliferation of ER-positive cells was specifically an in vitro cell-line finding, not a demonstrated in vivo/clinical mechanism per the label.
suggested_rewrite: Add 'in vitro' qualifier: state that in vitro, palbociclib reduced ER-positive breast cancer cell line proliferation via blocked G1-to-S transition, per label Section 12.1.
